anatomy.name: The crucifix
anatomy.prayed: Where the Rosary begins and ends. Hold it for the Sign of the Cross and the Apostles' Creed.

anatomy.name: The first large bead
anatomy.prayed: An Our Father, the prayer Jesus taught.

anatomy.name: The three small beads
anatomy.prayed: Three Hail Marys, asking for an increase of faith, hope and charity.

anatomy.name: The next large bead
anatomy.prayed: The Glory Be first, on reaching it. Then the first mystery is announced, and its Our Father said on this bead.

anatomy.name: The medal
anatomy.prayed: Where the loop begins, and where the Rosary is closed with the Hail, Holy Queen.

anatomy.name: A decade
anatomy.prayed: Ten small beads: ten Hail Marys while you think about one mystery. There are five decades, one for each mystery.

anatomy.name: The large beads between
anatomy.prayed: On each, the Glory Be and the Fatima Prayer close one decade; then the next mystery is announced, and its Our Father said on the same bead.

steps.instruction: Take the crucifix in your hand. Touch your forehead, your breast, your left shoulder and your right as you say:
Still holding the crucifix, profess the faith of the Church. Everything the Rosary is about is in this prayer.
Move your fingers up to the first large bead, and pray the prayer Jesus taught His disciples.
On each of the next three small beads, a Hail Mary. This first one asks God for an increase of faith.
The next small bead: a Hail Mary for an increase of hope.
The next small bead: a Hail Mary for an increase of charity.
Move up to the next large bead. Before anything else is said on it, give glory to the Holy Trinity.
Now the heart of the Rosary. Each decade is spent with one scene from the life of Jesus and Mary. Say its name, aloud or silently, and picture it.
On the large bead, the Our Father. Keep the scene before you as you pray.

The next bead. If your mind wanders, simply come back to the scene.
